主要内容: Zoom Video Communications Inc. reported its first quarterly earnings since its IPO, surpassing revenue estimates and providing guidance that exceeded analyst expectations. The company reported revenue of $122 million for the first quarter of 2020, while analysts had expected $111.7 million. Zoom also guided for full fiscal year revenue between $535 million and $540 million, significantly above the $520.3 million expected by analysts. The stock surged 18.4% following the report, adding $3.7 billion to its market cap, which now stands at $24.1 billion. Zoom's performance stood out among its tech IPO peers, as it was already profitable before going public. Analysts highlighted the company's strong financial metrics and ongoing momentum, though some cautioned about slowing customer growth and potential saturation if Zoom Phone does not ramp up. The report has sparked mixed reactions, with bulls pointing to record customer additions and strong ARPU growth, while bears focus on the slowing expansion of existing customers.
